order: Tighten launch discipline for the cross-vendor executor and reviewer launchers. Every launcher starts from the repository root, not an arbitrary working directory. Relative paths then resolve consistently, regardless of where the parent process was invoked from. Each launcher's output goes into the shared scratch directory instead of scattering. The review warmup step pins to a known checkout for every run. It exercises exactly the state the review will actually run against. That checkout is never stale or unrelated to the review at hand. Apply the same three fixes across all three files in the set. Those files are the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launcher script. Their startup behavior stays consistent with one another across the board. Keep each script's existing command-line interface the same. The startup and warmup discipline are the only pieces that change here. Every other behavior in these files carries over precisely as it did before.
claims: We fixed launch discipline across exactly three launcher scripts in total. Each one now starts only from the repository root, never elsewhere. Each script also writes its own output only to the scratch directory, and pins the warmup to the checkout under test. The three files changed by 90 added lines and 24 removed lines. That covers the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launchers, all kept consistent. Each script's startup path was traced manually, line by line, to verify the repo-root behavior.
